effect:
A quite rare commemorative Ball.

Cherish Ball is typically reserved for event Pokémon and special distributions. It functions like a regular Poké Ball but has a different red-and-black design that is supposed to make it special!

You can get Cherish Balls in this game via gifts and Sliph Co 3F.
